shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone slab
repeated curling/curving linear forms (spirals in A; curled beards and hair in B)
justification: A shows purely abstract ornament  spspirals, S-curves and a central interlaced disc flanked by symmetrical scrolling bands, with no figures at all, while B shows bearded human figures in profile with elaborate curled hair, headgear and a raised hand. The only shared traits are the generic use of shallow relief on a slab and a taste for tight repeated curls, which any tradition could arrive at independently; there is no shared subject, relationship or scheme.
